The '''Quarantine section''' was where the [[Outbound Flight Colony]] kept its [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children under surveillance because of their [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|Anti-Jedi sentiment]]. [[Peacekeeper (Outbound Flight Colony)|Peacekeepers]] [[Perry]] and [[Quinze]] were assigned here<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Two attendants, one [[Unidentified attendant|young]] and the other [[Unidentified attendant (older)|older]] cared for the children being held there.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
